column1: # Mario vs. Donkey Kong (Switch, 2024; base game v0 + update 1.0.1 = v65536): Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys engine with NintendoWare G3d2 / Ui2d / Vfx2 / Font (as Super Mario Bros. Wonder), SDK 15.3.0, NVN;
# modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: the intro and cutscene movies, Movie/*.mp4, H.264 + AAC) + sdk. RomFS: zstd files (.zs, most of them models), BWAV sound.

# Shaders: agl's sharcb (BAHS) in Lib/agl/agl_resource.Nin_NX_NVN.release.sarc.zs, the models' MaterialUber.bfsha in Model/*.sarc.zs, Shader/Sample.Nin_NX_NVN.release.sarc.zs and BNSH in main: 12,691.
# Started from porter's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py); its memory values held
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# gsys clears its targets under render conditions (as Tears of the Kingdom): run unconditionally, a clear wiped the lit HDR scene before the composite and levels were black under the HUD
# source groups without path separators: the sources are RomFS paths, written with backslashes when the split runs on Windows
